about: lev_5_m3: the level start: the briefing (or the 600-frame fallback) dismissed, Roman's spawn, camera, the first enemies and triggers for 10 s (traced from 60 frames before play frame 0, so events before a later briefing in one game are seen), a 2 s walk forward from 2 s

known.companion.q.pos: C1: Q's stop on the AI grid (navgrid.rs, 2026-10-26): on the bridge he follows the original's cell column (x -3045.4) at its distance, but the remaster's Roman stops 2.1 units further (y 3227.6 against 3229.7, across the cell line 3229.45), so the last route's snapped cell is one further and Q stops 19.6 behind him instead of 27.2 (12 units from the original's spot); afterwards the walker creeps about 1 unit/s on the planks where the original stands
known.events.sounds: B17 rest (the sound causes fixed by agent-sound): what is left comes from other families or chance: load-time sounds outside one game's traced window (B10 / E1 start message timing: the base levels' loops, the first ambient one-shot at load vs frame 2), random picks (ambient one-shots, thunder, sheep bleats), the grunts' gait (walk vs run footstep notes, charanim.rs), the grunts' _ic anim-event lines and boulder rolls (not in the remaster yet), vehicle loops (B14, vehicles not traced)
known.grunt.pos: B3b: lifted out of the overhang as in the original, he falls past its underside in the remaster; the original's body stops dead against the back of an 82-degree landscape face (contact from play frame 3, velocity 0 from frame 5, awake; docs/open-questions.md)
